git commit -m "feat(transport): answer list_sessions over the socket

Implements the list_sessions frame in the ws message handler: the socket's
own user's listFor summaries as session_list (empty when the store leaves
listFor out), INVALID_MESSAGE for malformed frames without calling listFor,
and SERVER_ERROR with a ws error log when listFor throws. Short answers
(ping, list_sessions) serialise per socket, so a pong never jumps the frame
answered before it and neither waits behind a streaming turn.

Deduplicates the ws suites' server/client scaffolding into wsTestSupport
(eventually, delegatingTo, draining stopEngines) and drops the boolean
literal in the validator test.
